purpose: the rule applied to every offered prefix that was on neither the collision list nor the pillar list
rule: add a prefix if its lowercase form is an English word, or a common abbreviation outside NUS that a student could type meaning something other than that department
leave it off if it is a department or subject code a student types to mean that department, or if the suite routes or joins on it
a dictionary hit stays off when the word is one a student would not type (an obscure dictionary-only word, or a proper noun only)
when unsure, add it: a listed token with digits still pins or routes, and only the bare token stops routing

source.corpus: eval/lib/corpus.mjs loadPinnedWith: 304 offered prefixes, 53 on the list before this review, 10 pillar prefixes, 241 reviewed here
source.dictionary: /usr/share/dict/words (macOS web2, Webster's Second), matched case-insensitively; read once when the list was built. This file is the result: nothing reads the dictionary at runtime or in CI.
